prompt: List the main components of this repository as JSON {"files": [...]} naming one representative file per component
truth_source: hand-curated by the leaf 1.5.6 bench agent, verified against source at 657f41c2cbe06039c0d82cf81c17759d1149eda2. Curation rule: anyq is a workspace whose components are its published packages, so the answer is one file per entry in the root package.json `workspaces` glob `packages/*` - eleven of them, each named in its own package.json (@anyq/core plus the ten driver packages azure-servicebus, cloudflare-queues, google-pubsub, kafka, memory, nats, rabbitmq, redis-streams, sns, sqs) - and the representative file is that package's `src/index.ts` entry, which exists for all eleven (checked). apps/testers/* and apps/examples/* are also workspaces but are consumers of the library rather than components of it, so they are excluded; the rule is stated here so the exclusion is auditable rather than a matter of taste.
